title: Tidy my inbox
subtitle: What needs you, what can wait, what to drop
description: Reads your recent email and sorts it into three: what needs you, what can wait, and the senders you could stop hearing from. It sends nothing and moves nothing, and saves a draft for you to read only if you ask.
asks: What in my inbox actually needs me?
Go through this week's email and tell me what to drop.
